title: P52 NCR
content: P52 pier concrete crack NCR. Inspection requires engineering disposition. Corrective action shall be verified before closure.

title: Variation procedure
content: A variation under the contract clause shall be valued for cost and assessed for schedule impact. A claim or EOT must retain evidence.

title: Work at height method
content: Work at height hazard controls are defined in the method statement. Inspection and permit evidence shall be retained before work proceeds.

title: Maintenance note
content: Maintenance task for bridge asset uses sensor telemetry and verification evidence to confirm closure.
